name: dashboard-7-showback-bill-admin
title: Showback · bill allocation
description: One selected closed report. Evidence kind is visible; SYNTHETIC fixtures are not a real bill. Snapshots are gauges, never integrated. Time picker changes do not recalculate allocation.

reportIdentity.title: Selected closed report — read evidence kind before presenting
reportIdentity.description: The series label identifies SYNTHETIC versus live evidence, immutable report ID, UTC period and policy. Value 1 means metadata is present. The time picker never recalculates this report.

queries.query: (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1))

total.title: Included hosting bill (USD)
total.description: Complete priced bill for the selected report. Missing price means NO DATA, never zero.

queries.query: (showback_report_cost_cents @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1))) / 100

known.title: Known priced subtotal (USD)
known.description: Priced portions only. This is not the full bill when pricing completeness is 0.

queries.query: (showback_report_known_cost_cents @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1))) / 100

pricing.title: Pricing complete (1=yes)
pricing.description: Every included paid interval has a recorded rate. Evidence kind distinguishes synthetic from observed inputs; a public-list estimate is not an invoice.

queries.query: (showback_report_pricing_complete @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1)))

allocation.title: Allocation complete (1=yes)
allocation.description: 0 means attribution or prices are unresolved; known amounts still reconcile.

queries.query: (showback_report_allocation_complete @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1)))

priceBasis.title: Report price basis — read label
priceBasis.description: Basis recorded in this immutable report, not today's price configuration. Value 1 denotes metadata presence; unspecified metadata is explicitly marked. A public-list estimate is not an account invoice.

queries.query: (showback_report_price_basis_info @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1)))

rateSources.title: Report rate evidence — read source labels
rateSources.description: Only rate IDs used by intervals overlapping this report. Value 1 identifies metadata; missing prices stay marked.

queries.query: (showback_report_rate_info @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1)))

exclusions.title: Excluded costs — read labels
exclusions.description: Exclusions captured with this report. Value 1 denotes an exclusion label, not a dollar amount. Unspecified exclusions are not assumed empty.

queries.query: (showback_report_exclusion_info @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1)))

consumers.title: Known bill allocation by team and platform bucket (USD)
consumers.description: Engineering, Marketing, Support, other_consumers, platform_idle and unresolved_allocation. Active-window cost includes quiet capacity. A fully idle, covered window belongs to platform_idle.

queries.query: (showback_report_allocated_cents @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1))) / 100

teamModel.title: Allocated cost by team and model (known USD)
teamModel.description: Sum of finalized model/window allocations for Engineering, Marketing and Support; no second allocation using whole-report token shares. Known costs with incomplete evidence remain unresolved; unpriced amounts are absent.

queries.query: (showback_report_model_allocated_cents{consumer=~"engineering|marketing|support"} @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1))) / 100

modelTotals.title: Full hosting cost by model (USD)
modelTotals.description: Sum of closed-window model costs, including idle windows. An incomplete model price is withheld.

queries.query: (showback_report_model_cost_cents @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1))) / 100

models.title: Hosting cost by model and closed window (USD)
models.description: Paid instance hours multiplied by verified rate; zero missing-price values are never fabricated.

queries.query: (showback_model_cost_cents @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1))) / 100

detail.title: Known window allocation detail (USD)
detail.description: All cents reconcile within each model/window. Unknown coverage assigns its known cost to unresolved_allocation.

queries.query: (showback_model_allocated_cents @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1))) / 100

coverage.title: Usage coverage (1=complete)
coverage.description: A missing interval is not an idle interval. Read the coverage label.

queries.query: (showback_model_coverage_complete @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1)))

name: dashboard-8-showback-usage-admin
title: Showback · usage and governance
description: Actual report consumption and the published configuration snapshot are separate. No reserved GPU capacity or fixed cost split is implied.

reportIdentity.title: Selected closed report — read evidence kind before presenting
reportIdentity.description: The series label identifies SYNTHETIC versus live evidence, immutable report ID, UTC period and policy. Value 1 means metadata is present. The time picker never recalculates this report.

queries.query: (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1))

teamModelTokens.title: Certified report tokens by team and model
teamModelTokens.description: Sum of closed-window tokens using the report's subscription/team mapping. Withheld for a model if any window has incomplete usage coverage.

queries.query: (showback_report_team_model_tokens @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1)))

tokens.title: Certified tokens by subscription, model and window
tokens.description: Input plus output tokens from canonical MaaS accounting. Partial observations are withheld from this panel.

queries.query: (showback_subscription_tokens @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1)))

shares.title: Actual token share within each model/window (%)
shares.description: These shares determine active-window cost shares. They are independent of configured token allowances.

queries.query: (showback_subscription_token_share_ratio @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1))) * 100

access.title: Configured model access (1=allowed, 0=denied)
access.description: Scenario captured when this snapshot was published: Engineering/Qwen, Marketing/Mistral, Support/both. Four allowed cells, two denied. This is configuration, not live policy or proof that enforcement passed.

queries.query: (showback_config_model_access @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1))

allowance.title: Configured token allowance
allowance.description: Scenario captured when this snapshot was published, with quota-window label. Values remain illustrative until calibrated. A short report is not an aligned quota counter, so remaining quota headroom is deliberately not inferred.

queries.query: (showback_config_allowance_tokens @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1))

allowanceShare.title: Configured allowance ratio (%)
allowanceShare.description: Qwen Engineering/Support 70/30 is an allowance proposal. It neither reserves GPU time nor fixes the cost split. Mistral values are independent placeholders.

queries.query: (showback_config_allowance_share_ratio @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1)) * 100

coverage.title: Usage coverage (1=complete)
coverage.description: Request/error/denial counts need separately reconciled runner receipts. Native request counters do not prove a model dimension. Denied attempts count as zero inference tokens only after pre-inference enforcement is proved.

queries.query: (showback_model_coverage_complete @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1)))

receiptInputs.title: Runner receipt input tokens
receiptInputs.description: Optional closed-window runner receipts, not native Limitador per-model counters. Absent receipt data stays NO DATA. Receipt input/output split is a cross-check, not the allocation denominator. Denied attempts add no separate cost charge. The bounded runner disables retries.

queries.query: (showback_receipt_input_tokens @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1)))

name: dashboard-9-showback-efficiency-admin
title: Showback · model cost and efficiency
description: Closed-report cost efficiency followed by clearly separate live vLLM/DCGM context. No per-team GPU cost model.

reportIdentity.title: Selected closed report — read evidence kind before presenting
reportIdentity.description: The series label identifies SYNTHETIC versus live evidence, immutable report ID, UTC period and policy. Value 1 means metadata is present. The time picker never recalculates this report.

queries.query: (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1))

fullCost.title: Full hosting cost by model/window (USD)
fullCost.description: Complete model/window cost includes paid quiet and idle capacity. Missing price stays NO DATA.

queries.query: (showback_model_cost_cents @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1))) / 100

workerRate.title: Effective worker USD per paid instance-hour
workerRate.description: Unrounded model/window hosting cost divided by evidenced paid instance-hours. This is a time-weighted worker rate when interval prices differ. Missing price or zero hours stays NO DATA.

queries.query: (showback_model_effective_worker_usd_per_hour @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1)))

reportWorkerRate.title: Effective worker rate across the report (USD/hour)
reportWorkerRate.description: Unrounded hosting cost divided by summed paid instance-hours for each model, with no dashboard price variables.

queries.query: (showback_report_model_effective_worker_usd_per_hour @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1)))

declaredRates.title: Recorded worker rates (USD/hour)
declaredRates.description: Numeric rates and provenance come from the selected report. Unknown rates are withheld.

queries.query: (showback_report_rate_usd_per_hour @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1)))

hours.title: Paid instance hours by model/window
hours.description: Hosting hours from the report's instance evidence, including idle capacity.

queries.query: (showback_model_instance_hours @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1)))

tokens.title: Certified tokens by model/window
tokens.description: Missing usage is NO DATA; covered idle is zero.

queries.query: (showback_model_tokens @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1)))

effective.title: Hosting USD per million actual tokens
effective.description: Full model/window hosting cost divided by measured tokens. Covered idle is undefined/NO DATA, not $0. Compare busy and quiet windows to show idle capacity's effect.

queries.query: (showback_model_effective_usd_per_million_tokens @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1)))

coverage.title: Usage coverage (1=complete)
coverage.description: Coverage applies to the selected closed report.

queries.query: (showback_model_coverage_complete @ end() and on(report_id, report_sha256, job, instance) (showback_selected_report_info @ end() and on(job, instance) (up{showback_publisher="selected-report"} @ end() == 1)))

throughput.title: Live model throughput — separate from the closed report
throughput.description: Native vLLM model-wide input/output rates over the visible time picker. Not per-team GPU accounting.

queries.query: sum by (model_name) (rate(kserve_vllm:prompt_tokens_total{model_name=~"qwen3-8-27b|mistral-small4-119b"}[5m]))
sum by (model_name) (rate(kserve_vllm:generation_tokens_total{model_name=~"qwen3-8-27b|mistral-small4-119b"}[5m]))

latency.title: Live model TTFT and inter-token latency (seconds)
latency.description: Native model histograms. Missing series stay empty; no zero-error or zero-latency fallback. End-to-end request latency awaits a verified runtime histogram.

queries.query: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (model_name, le) (rate(kserve_vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"qwen3-8-27b|mistral-small4-119b"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (model_name, le) (rate(kserve_vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"qwen3-8-27b|mistral-small4-119b"}[5m])))

gpu.title: Live GPU utilization by model (%)
gpu.description: NVIDIA DCGM utilization via the repository's ServiceMonitor model_name mapping. No GPU usage is attributed to teams. Power and model-specific errors await verified series and units.

queries.query: avg by (model_name) (accelerator_gpu_utilization{model_name=~"qwen3-8-27b|mistral-small4-119b"})

queue.title: Live model queue depth (requests)
queue.description: Raw UWM vLLM waiting-request gauge, as used by the repository's VLLMRequestQueueBacklog rule. Missing metrics remain empty; this is operational context, not closed-report billing evidence.

queries.query: sum by (model_name) (vllm:num_requests_waiting{model_name=~"qwen3-8-27b|mistral-small4-119b",namespace="internal-models"})

memory.title: Live GPU framebuffer used (exporter MB)
memory.description: Raw DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED with the MB display convention in the repository's NVIDIA console dashboard. No byte conversion or per-team/model attribution. Labels identify the exporter host/instance, consuming pod and GPU. Runtime label/scrape compatibility still requires qualification.

queries.query: max by (Hostname, instance, gpu, exported_pod) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{exported_pod=~"(qwen3-8-27b|mistral-small4-119b)-kserve-.*"})

display.title: Live operational context — dashboard time picker
